# Plan: Deploy the game to GitHub Pages

## Design

Add `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, triggered on push to `main` and `workflow_dispatch`.

- `build` job: `contents: read`. Checkout without persisted credentials, set up Node 24.22.0 with the same pinned action SHAs as `browser-tests.yml`, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, upload `dist` with `actions/upload-pages-artifact`.
- `deploy` job: needs `build`, with only `pages: write` and `id-token: write`, in the `github-pages` environment, using `actions/deploy-pages`.
- `concurrency: pages` with `cancel-in-progress: false`, so a running deployment finishes.

Deployment prerequisite, outside this change: the maintainer enabled Pages with `POST repos/supernovae/signal-lost/pages build_type=workflow`, which returned `https://supernovae.github.io/signal-lost/`. It cannot be observed from the sandbox, so it is treated as unverified until the post-merge observation. No secret or token is added, and nothing reaches the client bundle.

Export `SITE_BASE` from a new `site.config.ts` (default `/signal-lost/`, still overridable by `SIGNAL_LOST_BASE`), and import it in `vite.config.ts`. Add `tests/unit/pages.test.ts`:

- reads the Vite base and asserts `/signal-lost/`;
- runs `vite build` to a temporary directory with the project config and asserts `index.html` references its script under `/signal-lost/assets/`.

## Files

- New: `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, `site.config.ts`, `tests/unit/pages.test.ts`
- Changed: `vite.config.ts`, and `tsconfig.json` only if the new root file is not already included (`*.ts` already covers it)

## Edge cases

- A failed build must not deploy: `deploy` needs `build`.
- The test build must not touch `dist/`, because other checks may use it.

## Out of scope

The custom 404 page and post-deploy smoke verification, which belong to the release WorkUnit.

# Test plan

| Acceptance criterion | Verification |
| --- | --- |
| Workflow builds with `npm ci` and `npm run build`, and deploys `dist` on push to main and manual dispatch | Reviewer reads `pages.yml`. `actionlint` is not in the toolchain, so YAML is parsed with `npx prettier --check`. After merge, the run on `main` must succeed and `https://supernovae.github.io/signal-lost/` must return 200. |
| Built `index.html` references assets under `/signal-lost/` | `npx vitest run tests/unit/pages.test.ts` |

Developer runs the focused commands above and `npm run lint`. The coordinator runs the complete required policy.
